cards.name: peace-be-still
cards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished premium square Bible verse art card for the Hope Cards Android app, 1536x1536 or highest quality square. This is an original artwork inspired by the user's examples of atmospheric photography and expressive mixed typography. Full bleed photograph of a still alpine lake in blue hour, distant pine silhouettes and subtle mist, dim turquoise reflections, soft fine photographic grain. Calm natural image, thoughtfully composed with quiet dark space across upper and middle portions, natural mountain silhouette near bottom. Exquisite editorial typography integrated directly into art: large beautiful ivory flowing brush calligraphy for "Be still," near upper middle, refined readable serif for the remaining scripture arranged in generous lines, letter-spaced small sans-serif for reference near bottom. Text must be exact, legible, no extra words: "Be still,
and know that I am God.
I will be exalted among the nations.
I will be exalted in the earth." Reference: "PSALM 46:10 · WEB". Tiny tasteful bottom branding "HOPE CARDS". Maintain 9 percent safe margins. Let Be still be the hero at 3x supporting text size. No rounded UI card, no device mockup, no border, no collage. Beautiful real photographic atmosphere, restrained premium design.

cards.name: strength-the-lord-is-good
cards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished premium square Bible verse art card for the Hope Cards Android app, highest quality square. Original atmospheric photographic background of dramatic mountain ridges at dusk, ochre sunset sky above and charcoal pine forest foreground below, tactile gentle film grain, natural cinematic landscape with quiet negative space for text. Typography is the star: sculptural bold expressive cream hand-painted brush uppercase lettering reading "THE LORD
IS GOOD," centered around upper third, paired with narrow condensed sans serif supporting lines below in warm ivory. Use different scale and expressive hand lettering from a conventional quote template. Exact entire verse text: "The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him." The first words appear only once as the large hand-lettered heading; remaining words below as "a stronghold in the day of trouble;
and he knows those who
take refuge in him." Reference near bottom "NAHUM 1:7 · WEB". Tiny bottom branding "HOPE CARDS". 9 percent safe margins, impeccable spelling, highly legible at phone size, balanced intentional line breaks. Full bleed image, no collage, no device, no border, no UI. Rich authentic outdoors photograph and professional hand-lettered Christian editorial design.

cards.name: joy-this-is-the-day
cards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished premium square Bible verse art card for Hope Cards app, highest quality square. Original fine-art botanical photograph: golden yellow wildflowers and delicate stems catching early morning light rising from bottom third, deep dark olive-green bokeh background transitioning toward softly glowing warm light in upper left, subtle grain, airy but richly photographic. Avoid flowers behind typography; quiet dark center. Very beautiful varied editorial typography: small widely tracked ivory sans serif "THIS IS THE DAY", delicate large elegant italic serif "that the LORD has made.", and magnificent golden handwritten flowing brush script hero "We will rejoice" across center, followed by small ivory uppercase sans-serif "AND BE GLAD IN IT!" Use exact scripture wording "This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!" Preserve full wording, capitalize stylistically as specified, no duplicated text. Small reference above bottom edge "PSALM 118:24 · WEB", tiny restrained branding "HOPE CARDS". Balanced spacing, lovely hand lettering, excellent contrast, generous 9 percent safe margins. Emphasize exquisite typography and original flower photography, no stock quote template, no border, no device mockup, no collage, no UI.
